brief.en: Stands firm and resists the magic from Qigong Zombies and Black Holes' suction
brief.zh: 稳固地立在地上，抵抗气功僵尸的法术和时空黑洞的吞噬

description.en: Resistant Radish stands firm and resists the magic from Qigong Zombies and Black Holes' suction.
description.zh: 白萝卜稳固地立在地上，抵抗气功僵尸的法术和时空黑洞的吞噬。

chat.en: Resistant Radish has studied qigong for many years, but he only learned one thing: stasis.
chat.zh: 白萝卜学了很多年气功, 但他一直都只会一招: 纹丝不动。

text.zh: 防止身后植物被法术抽吸
